name: David Burton
tagline: Brooklyn guy who likes to pretend he's a photographer.
page_title: David Burton — film photography, live music, Brooklyn
meta_description: Home base for David Burton: 35mm concert, travel and New York photography, the Worn on Tour portrait project, the If You Get Confused newsletter, and five-star reviews of burritos.
footer_line: Shot on 35mm in and around New York City. Scanned by Nice Film Club.

words: walks up to strangers in band tees
hero.intro: I picked up a film camera at my parents' place during the pandemic and have slowly used it more and more. I've always wanted to get really good at taking pictures. That's still a work in progress. In the meantime this is where the pictures live, along with everything else I can't stop talking about.

photos_section.heading:
Photos, by the
roll they came off
photos_section.lede: Four film series and one digital one. Concerts are the reason the camera exists. Everything else is what happened between shows.

worn_on_tour.title: Worn on Tour
worn_on_tour.note: band tees, on film, on strangers
worn_on_tour.quote: It can be a tad uncomfortable to walk up to random people and ask to take a picture of them. So far it's been worth the awkwardness.
worn_on_tour.body: A portrait project that combines the two hobbies: music and photography. Portraits, on film, of people around New York City wearing cool band merchandise. Neil Young tank tops, Smiths tees, Dead shirts that have clearly been to a lot of shows.

reviews_section.heading:
Things I love,
on a five-star scale
reviews_section.intro: Borrowed from John Green's The Anthropocene Reviewed, and from a year-end newsletter where I rated the year on a five-star scale. Just a bit of fun.
reviews_section.source_label: Read the full year in review

newsletter.title: If You Get Confused
newsletter.subtitle: A newsletter meant to be listened to.
newsletter.origin: Named for the Grateful Dead lyric: "If you get confused, listen to the music play." It's a method that has always worked for me.
newsletter.footnote: Issue numbers in order of how much I overthought them.

bucket_section.heading:
Rooms worth
traveling for
bucket_section.intro: Venues worth traveling for. Underrated places, something funky about the room, music I actually like, and logistics that won't ruin it for an anxious person.
